observations: The article describes an enlarged chapter house and a new basement chapter room with a blue tile floor, platform, sound-treated ceiling and support rooms.
It describes a first-floor green-slate hall, dining room and a former dining room converted into a paneled lounge; historic photos show the dining room/lounge at that time.
It describes dormitory/bedrooms and shared facilities on upper floors after the addition.
historical_archival_reference.model_use: Used to support only the broad arrangement/use categories represented: basement chapter room, first-floor entry/common rooms, upper sleeping rooms.
historical_archival_reference.limits: Historical renovation-era text and photos; not a current measured or georeferenced floor plan. Exact partitions, current finishes, furniture and present room uses remain unverified.

observations: Contemporary description places the chapter room and game room in the basement; a central hall, living and dining rooms on the first floor; studies and bedrooms on the second floor; and dormitories under the roof on the third floor.
additional_historical_reference.limits: Historic use description, not evidence of present layout or exact dimensions.

additional_visual_reference.observation: Reports the 1935-built Gamma Delta house had two additions, describes the visible blue shutters and KKG letters over the threshold, and mentions basement movie nights.
